Chat response truncated due to max_tokens limit with finish_reason of length

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"max_tokens\":5,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Tell me a long story\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(request)
    println(result.choices)
    println(result.choices.first().finishReason)
}
```
